answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Each submission hangs on the ripple of a task receipt, and the wharf is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The timber of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
